About

Frontend engineer with three years building enterprise-grade admin consoles, role-based dashboards, and workflow-management UIs — mostly in React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, for operators who spend their whole shift inside these screens.

I spend as much time on the data underneath as the UI on top: wiring REST and GraphQL into dense, fast interfaces, keeping state predictable with Redux‑Saga, and shipping through Dockerized CI/CD onto AWS. QA runs through Cypress and Postman; production issues surface through Sentry and Elastic Cloud before users have to report them.
